definitions.explanation: money given to children by adults during the New Year holiday period

examples.japanese: お{年玉|としだま}をもらう。
{姪|めい}っ{子|こ}にお{年玉|としだま}を{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: I gave New Year's money to my niece.

examples.japanese: お{年玉|としだま}は{専用|せんよう}の{袋|ふくろ}に{入|い}れて{渡|わた}すのがマナーだ。
examples.english: It's proper etiquette to give New Year's money in a special envelope.
